The club competes in [[La Liga]], the top tier of [[Spanish football league system|Spanish football]]. Founded in 1902 as Madrid Football Club, the club has traditionally worn a white home kit. The [[Title of honour|honorific title]] 'Real' is Spanish for "Royal" and was bestowed by [[Alfonso XIII]] in 1920. Real Madrid have played their home matches in the [[Bernabéu (stadium)|Bernabéu]] since 1947. Unlike most European sporting clubs, Real Madrid's members have owned and operated the club throughout its history. The club is one of the most widely supported in the world and the most followed sports club across social media.Dongfeng Liu, Girish Ramchandani (2012). "The Global Economics of Sport", p. 65, Routledge.{{Cite web |title=Clubs with the most followers on social networks – CIES Football Observatory |url=https://football-observatory.com/WeeklyPost467 |access-date=2025-01-14 |website=football-observatory.com}} It was estimated to be worth $6.6 billion in 2024, making it the world's [[Forbes list of the most valuable football clubs|most valuable football club]].{{Cite news |last1=Ozanian |first1=Mike |last2=Tietelbaum |first2=Justin |date=23 May 2024 |title=The World's Most Valuable Soccer Teams 2024 |url=https://www.forbes.com/lists/soccer-valuations/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220529092638/https://www.forbes.com/sites/mikeozanian/2022/05/26/the-worlds-most-valuable-soccer-teams-2022-real-madrid-worth-51-billion-back-on-top/?sh=1e3891c7286b |archive-date=29 May 2022 |access-date=23 May 2024 |work=[[Forbes]]}} In 2024, it became the first football club to make €1 billion ($1.08bn) in revenue.{{Cite web |title=Real Madrid first club in world to report €1bn in revenue |url=https://abcnews.go.com/Sports/real-madrid-club-world-report-1bn-revenue/story?id=112222921 |access-date=2024-07-24 |website=ABC News |language=en}} The club anthem is the "[[Hala Madrid y nada más]]".{{Citation |title=Hala Madrid...y nada más (feat. RedOne) |date=27 May 2014 |url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Yc-7IQqcqeM |access-date=23 June 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230325210147/https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Yc-7IQqcqeM |archive-date=25 March 2023 |url-status=live |language=en}} Real Madrid is one of the [[List of football clubs by competitive honours won|most successful football clubs in the world]] and [[List of UEFA club competition winners|the most decorated club in Europe]]. In [[Football records and statistics in Spain|Spanish domestic football]], the club has won 71 trophies; [[La Liga records and statistics#Titles|a record]] 36 La Liga titles, 20 [[Copa del Rey]], 13 [[Supercopa de España]], a [[Copa Eva Duarte]] and a [[Copa de la Liga]].{{cite web |title=World Football: The 11 Most Successful European Clubs in History This success was replicated on the domestic front, with Madrid winning 12 league titles in 16 years.
